instruction: Like all the venmo transactions from yesterday or today involving any of my coworkers on my venmo social feed.
notes: Supervisor usernames (phone number for phone, email for venmo) come from supervisor.show_profile; passwords from show_account_passwords. phone.search_contacts with query/relationship = coworker yields all coworker emails in one (paginated) call, modeled as the nullary-per-relationship knowledge fact (contacts-known coworker). venmo.show_social_feed reveals the feed (feed-shown) and phone.get_current_date_and_time gives the reference date needed to judge 'yesterday or today'. Because the goal must name concrete transactions and supervisor-complete-task's precondition must restate the goal, the feed transactions are declared as domain constants: two representative qualifying transactions (recent, involving a coworker) plus two distractors (an old coworker transaction and a recent non-coworker one) whose preconditions make them un-likeable, matching the evaluator's requirement that exactly the recent coworker transactions get new likes and nothing else changes. The ?p parameter of venmo-like-transaction is a non-API record identifying the coworker participant. Relationship 'coworker' is a domain constant so like-transaction needs no extra relationship parameter. At runtime one like_transaction call is made per qualifying feed entry (the count is unknown a priori; two are modeled).
